title: Smart AI Checkout
description: Detect fruit from a Raspberry Pi camera feed and assemble an itemised bill.
sections: Explore a checkout workflow that recognises produce without barcodes or manual item entry.

A Raspberry Pi camera streams over the local network. A user-triggered scan samples ten frames at 0.15-second intervals, filters fruit detections, aggregates quantities, and generates a GST-ready bill.
Run inference on demand rather than continuously. Show confidence scores, included and excluded detections, and an annotated frame so results can be inspected.
Live video, a custom-trained YOLOv8 detector, itemised billing, summary metrics, a debug inspector, and annotated images.
Computer vision checkout prototype. Detection accuracy, billing reliability, and deployment outcomes have not been supplied.
